# Impulse Lane

> Glitter-filled dumpling squishies for stress relief and collecting.

## About

Impulse Lane sells glitter-filled dumpling (bao) shaped squishy collectibles. All products are adult collectible fidgets designed for ages 14 and up. These are novelty items for stress relief, not children's toys.

Products are sold in multipacks only (2, 4, or 6 per pack). Each squishy contains visible glitter, beads, or crystal fill.

## Shipping

- Ships within United States only
- Flat rate: $4.99 (free on orders $35+)
- Processing: 2-4 business days
- Delivery: 5-10 business days after shipping

## Returns

- Unopened: 30 days for product price refund (buyer pays return shipping)
- Damaged/defective: 14 days with photos for replacement or refund
- Opened packs: Not returnable except for defects

## Important Notes

- Age 14+ adult collectible fidgets
- Not children's toys
- Choking hazard for children under 3
- Site is currently in Stripe test mode (not fulfilling real orders)
